text_block_list.text:
On the way back from going out with Fuji 
Kiseki――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh.
At the end of Fuji Kiseki's gaze――

There was a poster for what seemed to be a 
theater-themed exhibition. It looks like 
today is the final day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure about this? I mean, we're 
going to get home a bit late...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thanks! Well then, I'll take you up 
on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—You know, this is said to be the very 
first work ever performed as a musical!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Back then, there was hardly any story, and 
the emphasis was all on flashy visuals.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look, Trainer! That outfit is super 
famous—

Fuji Kiseki, who usually spends all her 
time escorting others, is rarely ever seen 
looking so utterly enthralled.
choice_data_list:
(I hope they enjoy themselves to the 
fullest today.)

text_block_list.text:
Watching over Fuji Kiseki as she walked 
through the exhibition hall with flushed 
cheeks and a delighted look, I continued 
alongside her.

After enjoying the exhibition for a while, 
as closing time drew near—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm...!

When I returned from the restroom, Fuji 
Kiseki was deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well... it's almost closing time, so I was 
thinking of checking out one last exhibit 
before heading home.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The last two choices were both so 
appealing that I just couldn't pick...!

She seems torn between the 'History of 
Musicals and Theater' exhibit and the 
'Guide to Underground Theater' exhibit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, it looks like my mother is 
being featured in 'The Footsteps of 
Musicals and Theatre.'"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In contrast, *A Guide to Underground 
Theater* featured a friend of mine from my 
children's theater days as a director, you 
see?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Both of them really caught my eye. I 
couldn't make up my mind, so I've been 
pacing back and forth...!

Still, time is running short. It seems 
best to give her a little push forward.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, she's my mother after all! Thank 
you for giving me that push!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we get going, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Some people say my mother was the one who 
sparked the musical craze in this country.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You see, back then musicals were 
considered to have a high barrier to 
entry, but she starred in the very first 
one whose attendance doubled expectations, 
leading to a long-running production."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides... look over here. Mother isn't 
just an actress, you know!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Seeking to bring a fresh audience into a 
theatrical world that had long fought over 
a small pie, they produced a performance 
built on novel ideas.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I'd go watch rehearsals at the 
studio, and the entire cast and crew 
treated me so wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Wait, what's this...?

Fuji Kiseki, who had been explaining 
things cheerfully, suddenly fell silent. 
Following her gaze—

text_block_list.name: Young Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, and tomorrow, I will fight for 
the sake of bread!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! U-Um, this was from the first 
time I performed on stage outside of the 
children's theater troupe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's just a minor supporting role, but... 
my mother is actually the lead! It's our 
first time standing on the same stage 
together!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"When I was stiff with nerves in the 
dressing room, everyone cracked jokes and 
gave me snacks to help me relax, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, this line from the wife's role! 
It's such a funny line. Ah, brings back 
memories!
choice_data_list: It's a precious memory, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You're right. Those were wonderful days.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... my mindset won't change from what 
it is now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What I want to be has never changed, past 
or present: the greatest entertainer there 
is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What's different is that I have my 
precious partner... I have you by my side.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Decades from now, maybe a day will come 
when we look back fondly on races just 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I hope we can look 
back and reminisce together like this 
again.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it's almost closing time! Let's 
head to the next spot soon.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, um... when you stare at me so 
intently, it kinda tickles!

I was able to spend some precious time 
together with Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. It's my friend's big 
moment, so of course I have to stay and 
watch!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for giving me a push. Alright... 
let's get going then!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Woah, street performances in shopping 
districts and renting out an entire train 
for a show?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Making underground theater more accessible 
to people—is it? That's amazing, you're 
really working hard at it.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Woman
text_block_list.text:
"—I had a close friend from my child-actor 
days. It's thanks to her that I was able 
to pursue the path I'm on today."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Is that... interview footage?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Woman
text_block_list.text:
""Back then, I had this strong belief that 
if it didn't sell, I wasn't a real 
professional... The more I wrote, the less 
I was able to create my own work.""

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Woman
text_block_list.text:
"And when I started getting bitter, that 
girl told me... Admiration isn't 
everything. You have to walk your own 
path, she said."

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Woman
text_block_list.text:
"And because of that, I was able to 
properly face what I truly wanted to do 
all over again."

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Woman
text_block_list.text:
"That girl has already stepped down from 
the theatrical path and moved on to 
racing, but—"

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Still, those words remain my emotional 
pillar to this day. ...Not that I've ever 
told them that, though!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, I'm kind of blushing... To think 
you'd feature me like this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We're about ten years apart in age, but 
we've been super close ever since our days 
in the children's theater troupe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They treated me as an equal even though I 
was just a kid, and we even talked about 
our dreams together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back... I'm glad to see they're 
doing well."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...But it's not just a memory.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dreaming, chasing dreams, and the strong 
mental fortitude required to do so...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I learned so much during my time in the 
children's theater troupe. Perhaps 
everything I do now is built upon that 
foundation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Both myself and her.

And so, the two of them continued to watch 
the interview together for a while.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. If you'd like, would you 
want to go see her performance together 
sometime?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to know about her too. The 
girl who became a piece of my trajectory."

Afterward, we immediately made plans to 
see a play. It was a day where I got to 
see a whole new side of Fuji Kiseki.
